tracks.purpose: Main menu and gameplay background music for the business tycoon sandbox game
tracks.description: Neutral instrumental corporate underscore: muted strings, warm Rhodes piano, very light percussion. 85 BPM. Restrained, professional, unobtrusive background for business tycoon UI. Seamlessly looped via crossfade.
tracks.prompt: Instrumental corporate underscore, no vocals. Muted strings, warm Rhodes piano, very light percussion. 85 BPM. Neutral, restrained, professional background for business tycoon game UI. No hooks, no chiptune, no ethnic timbres, no epic crescendos. Controlled dynamics.
tracks.note: Prepared for seamless looping: original fade-in (0.25 s) and fade-out (~4.8 s) removed, last 2.5 s crossfaded with first 2.5 s, RMS level matched to original, peak 0.95. The game loops it by replaying on the AudioStreamPlayer.finished signal at -9 dB.
